description.content:
Delete a private Helm repository configuration. This will remove access to the private repository and all its associated configurations. This action is irreversible.

**Example Request:**
```
DELETE /v1/cluster/instances/kubernetes/helm/repository/id/private-repo-abc123
```

**Example Response:**
```json
{
  "operationType": "OPS_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED",
  "operationStatus": "OPS_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED",
  "objectKind": "",
  "objectId": "private-repo-abc123",
  "objectName": "company-charts",
  "objectRevision": "",
  "objectType": "OBJECT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED",
  "operationTime": "",
  "startTime": "",
  "endTime": "",
  "user": "",
  "httpStatusCode": 200,
  "httpStatusMsg": "",
  "jobId": "",
  "error": [
    {
      "ec": "zMsgSucess",
      "location": "",
      "details": ""
    }
  ]
}
```

**Warning:** This operation will remove the private repository configuration and stop access to its charts. Any deployments using charts from this repository may be affected.

**Note:** The private_repo_id parameter is **required** and must be a valid repository identifier.

description.content:
Retrieve a list of available Helm charts from a specific private repository with their versions and metadata.

**Example Request:**
```
GET /v1/cluster/instances/kubernetes/helm/repository/id/private-repo-abc123/charts
```

**Example Response:**
```json
{
  "api_version": "v2",
  "generated": "2024-01-15T12:00:00Z",
  "repo_identifier": "company-charts-repo",
  "repo_name": "Company Private Repository",
  "entries": {
    "company-app": [
      {
        "name": "company-app",
        "version": "2.1.0",
        "app_version": "1.5.0",
        "description": "Company proprietary application",
        "created": "2024-01-10T09:00:00Z",
        "digest": "sha256:abc123def456...",
        "urls": ["/charts/company-app-2.1.0.tgz"]
      },
      {
        "name": "company-app",
        "version": "2.0.0",

        "digest": "sha256:def456ghi789...",

      }

    "internal-service": [
```
